# AI reference-store daily preset

This configuration-only bundle declares `ai-reference-store-daily`. It preserves the supplied-task-only persona, native task provider, executable/store locations, and receipt directory. Selecting the preset does not start a daily batch; the daily application's profile owns that operation.

Maintain the declaration here and deploy its release archive through the DSH plugin CLI. The Harness home stores profile selection and overrides, not the maintained preset source. The retired directory-format files are preserved in Git history; the active declaration is `cordis.patch.yml`.

The existing preset name and description provide its user-facing identity. This source relocation does not add a new UI feature or change its appearance.

# deepseek-harness-plugins

English | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Unofficial plugins, local forks, presets, skills, and maintenance tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). This is a source collection, not a single installable plugin or a distribution of DSH.

## Contents

- [Repository structure](#repository-structure)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [Plugins and presets](#plugins-and-presets)
- [Skills](#skills)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Development](#development)
- [Repository scope and ownership](#repository-scope-and-ownership)
- [License](#license)

## Repository structure

Each directory below is a source collection, not a deployment inventory. Cloning the repository installs and enables nothing.

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| [plugins/](plugins/) | Plugin sources, local forks, and retained reference implementations, one directory per component. [plugins/dsh-web-ui/packages/](plugins/dsh-web-ui/packages/) keeps its nested package layout. |
| [presets/](presets/) | Agent-preset declarations: a manifest and a Cordis patch per preset. Declaring a preset does not install the packages its rows name. |
| [configs/](configs/) | Configuration-only bundles and service configuration, with no runtime code. See [its README](configs/README.md). |
| [skills/](skills/) | Authored skills and upstream-derived copies, one directory per skill. |
| [bin/](bin/) | Maintainer scripts that build, pack, and check packages, the weekly maintenance helpers, and the [runtime placement](bin/runtime-placement.md) notes. Not a public CLI. |
| [scripts/](scripts/) | The read-only [local setup diagnostic](scripts/local-setup.mjs). |
| [tests/](tests/) | Vitest configuration and upgrade regression specs that are not package-local. |
| [tasks/](tasks/) | Change cards for the kstack card-flow, one file per card, each tied to one issue. See [its README](tasks/README.md). |
| [docs/](docs/) | [Layout migration](docs/layout-migration.md) and [maintenance scope](docs/maintenance-scope.md) notes, and the retained [implement-task flow diagram](docs/implement-task-flow.html). |
| [.agents/](.agents/) | Development notes and the harness-facing skills for working on this repository. |
| [.claude/skills/](.claude/skills/) | Project-local skills loaded by Claude Code when working in this repository. Currently contains [verify-dsh-plugins](.claude/skills/verify-dsh-plugins/SKILL.md), which starts a disposable DSH host with a chosen plugin and mock LLM to verify the web UI and headless CLI with screenshots and logs. Machine-specific settings live in `.env` (described by `.env.example`). |

Root documents: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) is the agent entry point ([CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) links to it); [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) describes the development flow; [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) describes runtime layering and verification limits; [SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md](SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md) with [core-exceptions.json](core-exceptions.json) defines the Core baseline.

A local working copy also holds ignored directories such as `reports/`, `releases/`, and `local-design/`. They contain private material and are not part of the published tree.

**Layout migration:** Existing installations, profiles, systemd units, and scripts may still refer to old root-level paths. Moving this repository's sources does not update them; inventory and migrate those references before replacing an active checkout. The retained Slack worker configuration contains machine-specific paths that need review before use elsewhere. Do not assume that an isolated checkout or a passing source test has migrated the live runtime. See the [migration checklist](docs/layout-migration.md).

## Compatibility

Choose an individual package and read its README before installing it. Packages target different DSH releases; presence in this repository does not mean a package supports your installed version.

- [DSH Evolve](plugins/dsh-evolve/README.md) declares DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` and Node.js `>=24.9.0`.
- [Prompt Compact](plugins/dsh-prompt-compact/README.md) targets DSH `0.2.1` and only replaces upstream prompt text whose fingerprint matches its reviewed version.
- The root [pnpm workspace](pnpm-workspace.yaml) retains development dependencies from the DSH `0.1.0-rc.8` line. Its build and test scripts are not a repository-wide compatibility check.
- Older adapters have package-specific requirements. In particular, the Web Search and Cursor invariant companions depend on a registry absent from current DSH master. Do not treat their older installation examples as current-version guidance.

The [maintenance scope](docs/maintenance-scope.md) distinguishes maintained extensions, retained reference implementations, and removed managed providers.

## Plugins and presets

These entry points describe each component's setup, behavior, and limitations; this is not an install-all list.

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [DSH Evolve](plugins/dsh-evolve/README.md) | Observes tool failures and repeated calls. Installation defaults to observation without LLM calls; proposal generation is opt-in, and activation and rollback require human commands. |
| [Prompt Compact](plugins/dsh-prompt-compact/README.md) | Opt-in, preset-scoped alternatives for the Workflow and Ralph prompt sections. Tool schemas and execution behavior remain unchanged; it registers no Cordis Skill. |
| [Goal acceptance](plugins/dsh-goal-acceptance/README.md) | Retains the original request and checks evidence records for Goal completion and initial delegation. Unused since the request acceptance pilot was removed, and not updated for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1, where some of its tests fail. |
| [Workflow result selection](plugins/dsh-workflow-results/README.md) | Saves a complete workflow result before returning selected fields through `resultKeys`; requires a tool replacement in the chosen preset. |
| [Codex transport recovery](plugins/dsh-codex-transport-recovery/README.md) | Classifies specific premature WebSocket closures as transport errors so the official retry policy can handle them. Does not add retries or change models. |
| [Sandbox facts](plugins/dsh-sandbox-facts/README.md) | Writes each bash call's sandbox mode, denial, enforcement and runner failure as a `tool_facts` NDJSON line for headless `--json` runs. Meant to be loaded only by worker runs. |
| [pi-ai server error recovery](plugins/dsh-pi-ai-server-recovery/README.md) | Classifies pi-ai failures that report a 5xx status only as text as server errors so the official retry policy can handle them. Does not add retries or change models. |
| [Workspace attach](plugins/dsh-workspace-attach/README.md) | Lets a headless run join a web workspace group through `DSH_WORKSPACE_ID`. The web host performs the attach. |
| [AI reference-store daily preset](presets/ai-reference-store-daily/README.md) | Declares the preset for a separately configured reference-store application. Selecting the preset does not start a daily batch. |

Older integrations and local forks:

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Web Search](plugins/dsh-web-search/README.md) — `@kkiyama117/dsh-web-search` | Keyless DuckDuckGo HTML search, ported from [pi-web-access](https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-web-access). |
| [Exa search compatibility](plugins/dsh-web-search-exa-compat/README.md) — `@local/dsh-web-search-exa-compat` | Keeps the Exa search provider of DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 on 0.2.2-rc.1, which removed it from Core. Copy the old row's configuration to the new row before enabling it. |
| [Cursor adapter](plugins/dsh-llm-cursor/README.md) — `@kkiyama117/dsh-llm-cursor` | Runs a Cursor SDK agent for each harness model call, with replay-state session continuity. |
| [Web UI family](plugins/dsh-web-ui/packages/) | Local copies of UI, SSH, Git graph, settings, and Modlens packages; consult each package's README. |
| [Market](plugins/dsh-market/README.md) | Local plugin-market copy with its own build and compatibility checks. |

Deployment-specific bundles and presets:

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Session connection cleanup](plugins/dsh-session-cleanup/README.md) | Listens to `session/disposed` and requests synchronous closure of session resources; does not clear all Sessions or await peer socket closure. |
| [Open-in-app icons](plugins/dsh-open-in-app-icons/README.md) | Serves cacheable generic fallback icons for selected local application URLs; does not discover missing icons automatically or alter existing launcher routes. |
| [Aistore structured reader](plugins/dsh-aistore-native-preset/README.md) | Declares the `aistore-native` preset for reader and reviewer child Sessions with scoped tool restrictions; missing presets reject creation without falling back. |
| [Slack intake](plugins/dsh-slack-intake/README.md) | Connects a DSH profile to the Go aistore CLI and runs one claimed reader or reviewer task through a fixed native Agent route; requires absolute paths to the executable and store, and never selects another model or provider. |
| [LLM fallback](plugins/llm-fallback/README.md) | Retries only the configured source provider/model on its explicit route list after a configured error before content (such as quota or rate limits); other requested models are not substituted. |
| [Local presets](presets/) | Preserves local behavior on current upstream subagent controls in `ai-reference-store-next`, recording its upstream base in `UPSTREAM.json`. |

[plugins/subagent-fallback/](plugins/subagent-fallback/) is not a bundle; it remains only as a reference for implement-task.

## Skills

[skills/](skills/) contains authored skills and upstream-derived copies. Cloning this repository does not install or enable them. Local deployments may link individual skill directories into a DSH skill search path; edit the source directory, not a separate copied version. Read each skill's prerequisites before enabling it.

| Skill | Purpose and prerequisites |
|---|---|
| [issue-driven-development](skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md) | Shared issue intake, feature and bugfix delivery, verification, and development-process improvement for humans and AI agents. See [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for this repository's setup. |
| [orchestrate-agents](skills/orchestrate-agents/SKILL.md) | Task formulation, direct-versus-delegated execution, and bounded orchestration. See its [runtime limits](skills/orchestrate-agents/README.md). |
| [archify](skills/archify/SKILL.md) | Local fork of [archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) for architecture visualization, with screenshot checks at 1920×1080 and 2048×1320. |
| [quint-lang](skills/quint-lang/SKILL.md) | Quint syntax and CLI reference, imported from [quint-llm-kit](https://github.com/quint-co/quint-llm-kit). |
| [quint-modeling](skills/quint-modeling/SKILL.md) | Build or review Quint specifications from requirements or source code. |
| [quint-execute-spec](skills/quint-execute-spec/SKILL.md) | Implement code against an existing Quint specification. |
| [quint-cli](skills/quint-cli/SKILL.md) | Container-based Quint CLI instructions; requires the documented container tool and image. |
| [quint-verify](skills/quint-verify/SKILL.md) | Run invariant and witness checks and produce a structured verification report. Requires the documented Quint container environment. |
| [slack-reference-intake](skills/slack-reference-intake/SKILL.md) | Reference intake for a separately configured private Go aistore, with authorized Slack access and DSH credentials. Not a standalone public demo. |
| [implement-task](skills/implement-task/SKILL.md) | Retained implementation-flow reference with a [Quint specification](skills/implement-task/spec/README.md). It depends on legacy `subagent-fallback` tools; migrate the callers and specification before using it with current DSH. |

[skills/verify-completion-gate/](skills/verify-completion-gate/spec/README.md) holds only a Quint specification, not a loadable skill.

## Installation

1. Install DSH separately and choose the target profile.
2. Check the selected package's README, manifest, and patch for DSH compatibility, prerequisites, and activation scope. Build compiled packages using their own development instructions before loading them.
3. Install only the selected bundle through DSH's Plugin Manager or plugin CLI. A bundle declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in its package manifest; the repository root and plain skill directories are not bundles.
4. Complete any package-specific opt-in steps. For example, Prompt Compact has an empty bundle patch and needs a row in a locally authored preset. DSH Evolve instead mounts in observation mode on installation.

For CLI usage from a DSH source checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --help
```

Use your own package location rather than the maintainer's filesystem paths in older examples. See the upstream [bundle publishing guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md) for profile installation. Do not edit shipped DSH presets to enable these extensions.

## Development

Use [Issues](https://github.com/kkiyama117/deepseek-harness-plugins/issues) to report problems or propose improvements. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) describes the shared human/AI development flow and this repository's verification and publication scope.

This README is the English source; README.ja.md is its line-aligned Japanese pair; change both together. AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and package READMEs are written in English. A package translation (README.zh.md or README.ja.md) is optional; when one exists it is updated in the same change, including any README.i18n.yaml record. These process/policy documents are maintained in Japanese only: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md](SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md), [docs/maintenance-scope.md](docs/maintenance-scope.md), [bin/runtime-placement.md](bin/runtime-placement.md), [bin/live-apply.md](bin/live-apply.md), and the issue-driven-development skill ([skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md](skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md)).

The root [package manifest](package.json) pins pnpm to `11.7.0`. The root workspace includes Web Search, Cursor, and five Web UI family packages—not every package in this repository.

| Root command | Scope |
|---|---|
| `pnpm install` | Installs dependencies for the root workspace using its lockfile. |
| `pnpm build` | Runs the build script of each workspace member. Builds are not all plain `tsc`; UI packages also bundle client assets. |
| `pnpm test` | Runs workspace-member test scripts with workspace concurrency set to one. |

For packages outside that workspace, follow their own README and package scripts. Do not use a passing root build or test run as evidence that those packages work with your DSH version. Compiled packages load generated output, not edited source; follow the package's rebuild and reload instructions.

The repository gate, `python3 bin/gate.py`, runs the checks of every package changed since `origin/main` that `bin/gate-checks.json` lists, plus the document checks, and fails for a changed package without an entry. Card-flow work uses it with the card dispatcher, `python3 bin/dispatch.py`; see the [card-flow adapter](AGENTS.md#card-flow-adapter).

The read-only [local setup diagnostic](scripts/local-setup.mjs) inspects a local DSH profile. It imports `plugins/dsh-market/lib/check.js`, so it requires a built Market package, which is outside the root workspace. It is not a fresh-clone setup command or an installer.

## Repository scope and ownership

This repository publishes plugin, preset, skill, test, and maintenance-tool sources. Credentials, private design and review material, execution reports, deployment inventories, local caches, and release archives stay outside Git. Review new files for sensitive data before committing; ignore rules are not a secret scanner.

The public history starts with a source-only snapshot; earlier local history is not available here. See [architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) for composition and verification limits, and the [source ownership policy](SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md) for the upstream Core baseline and reviewed exception.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Preserve the upstream license and attribution notices included with imported code, forks, and skills.

Local deployments may link individual skill directories into a DSH skill search path; edit the source directory, not a separate copied version. Read each skill's prerequisites before enabling it.

| Skill | Purpose and prerequisites |
|---|---|
| [issue-driven-development](skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md) | Shared issue intake, feature and bugfix delivery, verification, and development-process improvement for humans and AI agents. See [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for this repository's setup. |
| [orchestrate-agents](skills/orchestrate-agents/SKILL.md) | Task formulation, direct-versus-delegated execution, and bounded orchestration. See its [runtime limits](skills/orchestrate-agents/README.md). |
| [archify](skills/archify/SKILL.md) | Local fork of [archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) for architecture visualization, with screenshot checks at 1920×1080 and 2048×1320. |
| [quint-lang](skills/quint-lang/SKILL.md) | Quint syntax and CLI reference, imported from [quint-llm-kit](https://github.com/quint-co/quint-llm-kit). |
| [quint-modeling](skills/quint-modeling/SKILL.md) | Build or review Quint specifications from requirements or source code. |
| [quint-execute-spec](skills/quint-execute-spec/SKILL.md) | Implement code against an existing Quint specification. |
| [quint-cli](skills/quint-cli/SKILL.md) | Container-based Quint CLI instructions; requires the documented container tool and image. |
| [quint-verify](skills/quint-verify/SKILL.md) | Run invariant and witness checks and produce a structured verification report. Requires the documented Quint container environment. |
| [slack-reference-intake](skills/slack-reference-intake/SKILL.md) | Reference intake for a separately configured private Go aistore, with authorized Slack access and DSH credentials. Not a standalone public demo. |
| [implement-task](skills/implement-task/SKILL.md) | Retained implementation-flow reference with a [Quint specification](skills/implement-task/spec/README.md). It depends on legacy `subagent-fallback` tools; migrate the callers and specification before using it with current DSH. |

[skills/verify-completion-gate/](skills/verify-completion-gate/spec/README.md) holds only a Quint specification, not a loadable skill.

## Installation

1. Install DSH separately and choose the target profile.
2. Check the selected package's README, manifest, and patch for DSH compatibility, prerequisites, and activation scope. Build compiled packages using their own development instructions before loading them.
3. Install only the selected bundle through DSH's Plugin Manager or plugin CLI. A bundle declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in its package manifest; the repository root and plain skill directories are not bundles.
4. Complete any package-specific opt-in steps. For example, Prompt Compact has an empty bundle patch and needs a row in a locally authored preset. DSH Evolve instead mounts in observation mode on installation.

For CLI usage from a DSH source checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --help
```

Use your own package location rather than the maintainer's filesystem paths in older examples. See the upstream [bundle publishing guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md) for profile installation. Do not edit shipped DSH presets to enable these extensions.

## Development

Use [Issues](https://github.com/kkiyama117/deepseek-harness-plugins/issues) to report problems or propose improvements. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) describes the shared human/AI development flow and this repository's verification and publication scope.

This README is the English source; README.ja.md is its line-aligned Japanese pair; change both together. AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and package READMEs are written in English. A package translation (README.zh.md or README.ja.md) is optional; when one exists it is updated in the same change, including any README.i18n.yaml record. These process/policy documents are maintained in Japanese only: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md](SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md), [docs/maintenance-scope.md](docs/maintenance-scope.md), [bin/runtime-placement.md](bin/runtime-placement.md), [bin/live-apply.md](bin/live-apply.md), and the issue-driven-development skill ([skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md](skills/issue-driven-development/SKILL.md)).

The root [package manifest](package.json) pins pnpm to `11.7.0`. The root workspace includes Web Search, Cursor, and five Web UI family packages—not every package in this repository.

| Root command | Scope |
|---|---|
| `pnpm install` | Installs dependencies for the root workspace using its lockfile. |
| `pnpm build` | Runs the build script of each workspace member. Builds are not all plain `tsc`; UI packages also bundle client assets. |
| `pnpm test` | Runs workspace-member test scripts with workspace concurrency set to one. |

For packages outside that workspace, follow their own README and package scripts. Do not use a passing root build or test run as evidence that those packages work with your DSH version. Compiled packages load generated output, not edited source; follow the package's rebuild and reload instructions.

The repository gate, `python3 bin/gate.py`, runs the checks of every package changed since `origin/main` that `bin/gate-checks.json` lists, plus the document checks, and fails for a changed package without an entry. Card-flow work uses it with the card dispatcher, `python3 bin/dispatch.py`; see the [card-flow adapter](AGENTS.md#card-flow-adapter).

The read-only [local setup diagnostic](scripts/local-setup.mjs) inspects a local DSH profile. It imports `plugins/dsh-market/lib/check.js`, so it requires a built Market package, which is outside the root workspace. It is not a fresh-clone setup command or an installer.

## Repository scope and ownership

This repository publishes plugin, preset, skill, test, and maintenance-tool sources. Credentials, private design and review material, execution reports, deployment inventories, local caches, and release archives stay outside Git. Review new files for sensitive data before committing; ignore rules are not a secret scanner.

The public history starts with a source-only snapshot; earlier local history is not available here. See [architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) for composition and verification limits, and the [source ownership policy](SOURCE-OWNERSHIP.md) for the upstream Core baseline and reviewed exception.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). Preserve the upstream license and attribution notices included with imported code, forks, and skills.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-session-index

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）+ WorkBuddy 的**全会话索引与跨会话记忆** MCP 插件。
> DSH 插件页 / pnpm 安装 → 之后全自动。零第三方依赖，源会话文件全程只读。

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 版本 | **v2.9.3** | **测试不再污染真实索引**：`test-panel` 先把真实索引的卡文件拷进临时目录、并把 `SESSION_INDEX_DIR` 指过去，再 import 宿主半身 —— 之前跑一次测试就会把**正在运行的 DSH 的 `server-path.txt`** 改成源码路径（门禁因此 FAIL，MCP 还可能被指回源码目录）。冒烟起的临时 server 也关掉面板 HTTP 通道（`SESSION_INDEX_HTTP_PORT=0`），不再和活实例抢 8799、不再把 `http-url.txt` 写成会失效的端口。README 新增「面板失效怎么查」三份日志速查表。 |
| **v2.9.2** | **真正的根因：同步模块用 `execFileSync` 跑 git，把 MCP 进程的事件循环卡住**。日志坐实：面板打开时的远端探测 `GET /api/sync/probe` 从 08:17:08.467 卡到 08:17:17.324（**8.85 秒**），期间面板的 `/api/health` 探活（900ms 超时）全部超时 → 「没有找到本地服务」→ 面板空白。git 一律改为异步 `execFile`（只剩 `gitAvailable` 保留一次本地快查并缓存），面板探活超时 900ms → 3000ms，远端探测延后 1.2 秒、不挡列表。新增回归测试：**故意慢 1.5 秒的假 git 远端 → 探测耗时 1783ms，期间面板 HTTP 6ms 秒回**。smoke 99 → 100、test-sync 51 → 54。 |
| **v2.9.1** | **面板「打不开 / 一片空白」可诊断**：面板 HTTP 通道的跨源判定放宽到「本机来源」（回环、本机名、`.localhost` 之类、本机自定义 scheme 如 `dsh-app://`），公网站点与局域网默认仍不放行（可用 `SESSION_INDEX_HTTP_ALLOW_ORIGIN` 单独放行）；面板失败时把两条通道各自的失败原因一并显示，并**自动向宿主机自报**（`<索引目录>/client-diagnostics.log`）；HTTP 服务记录每次请求的 Origin 与状态码（`<索引目录>/http-access.log`）—— 「面板空白」从此在宿主机上可定位，不用靠猜。 |
| **v2.9.0** | **另一台终端「装了就能用」**：工具不再把同步来的会话当空气 —— 守卫从「只看 meta」改成「meta 或会话卡」，`list` 补上同步来的会话（标 `imported`），`get` 在本机没原文时返回会话卡形态（结论/提问/路径，不是报错），`search` 把会话卡纳入精确与语义召回，`recall` 照常召回同步来的记忆。远端地址三级解析（环境变量 → 本机已保存 → 包内 `sync.default.json`）+ **首启自举**（本地一张卡都没有时自动拉一次），新机器不用手填地址。`sync_status` 改为只读本地，远端探测拆到 `sync_probe`（面板不再每次打开都打 git 网络）。`test-sync` 40 → 51。 |
| **v2.8.1** |
| 运行要求 | Node **≥ 22.15**（需要 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`） |
| MCP 能力 | **14 个工具** / 4 个提示词 / 8 个资源 |
| 第三方依赖 | **0**（只用 Node 标准库） |
| 完整手册 | [`操作使用手册.html`](./操作使用手册.html)（单页 14 章，导航 / 搜索 / 一键复制） |

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的会话存在 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 下，是**上千个独立 zstd 帧拼接**的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`，单文件可达 20 MB。
想在新会话里回顾旧结论，只能整包解压翻全文——慢，而且极耗 token。

本插件把全部会话**预先索引成结构化记忆单元**（会话卡：提问、结论、涉及路径、工具、关键词、血缘），
之后一次工具调用就能拿到结论速览，用关键词只取命中片段，**不必再把几十 MB 历史灌进上下文**。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：DSH 插件页（推荐 · 零命令行）

1. 打开 DSH → **插件页**
2. 粘贴仓库地址：`https://github.com/Lau-Jin/DSH`
3. 点安装，按提示**完全退出 DSH 再打开**（最小化无效）

装完就是可用状态，不用改配置、不用跑脚本、不用管 Node 路径。「已安装」列表与详情页会显示插件图标（`icon.svg`，卡片 + 放大镜）。

> 地址带不带 `.git` 都能装：不带时 pnpm 直接走 codeload 下 tarball，**不依赖本机 git**；
> 带上 `.git` 会先做一次 `git ls-remote` 解析版本。网络抖动时前者更稳。
> 实测这两条路都能装成（本机约 80–100 秒，主要是 GitHub 往返延迟，包本身只有 83 KB）。

**它为什么能自己找到入口**——插件包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会随 bundle 自动应用，挂两行：

| 行 id | 包 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `session-index-host` | `dsh-session-index` | 宿主半身（`lib/index.mjs`）：用 `import.meta.url` 解析**真实安装目录**，把 `server.mjs` 绝对路径写进 `~/.dsh/session-index/server-path.txt`；另注册 `session-index` 斜杠命令，并往 `~/.dsh/session-index/host-half.log` 追加自诊断行 |
| `mcp-session-index` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | MCP stdio 客户端：14 工具 / 4 提示词 / 8 资源 |

那行配置里的 `command`、`args`、`DSH_HOME` 三处都是 `!!js` 表达式，**在 DSH 加载配置时求值**（不是安装时），
按「显式环境变量 → 宿主记下的路径文件 → profile 标准安装位置」依次探测。
所以仓库放哪、pnpm 装到哪、换了 Node 版本，都不需要改文件。

宿主行排在前、MCP 行排在后，路径文件先落盘，MCP 侧首次 spawn 就能命中——**一次重启即生效**。

### 方式 B：pnpm / npm 安装（标准流程 · 推荐命令行用户）

插件已发布到 npm，包名 `dsh-session-index-lau`。在 DSH profile 目录执行：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add dsh-session-index-lau          # 安装
pnpm update dsh-session-index-lau       # 升级到最新版
pnpm remove dsh-session-index-lau       # 卸载
```

bundle 由包内 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动挂载，宿主半身按运行时探测解析 `server.mjs` 路径，MCP 客户端随 bundle 一起加载；安装 / 升级 / 卸载后**完全退出 DSH 再打开**即生效。

> **标准流程铁律**：所有插件更新统一走「仓库代码更新 → npm 包发布 → 插件安装更新」三段式。不再有本地 `link:` 安装、一键脚本或旧宿主兼容转发；禁止手工改 `profile/node_modules` 副本（pnpm 重装会按 registry 还原）。

> **本地迭代例外（2026-11-16 踩过）**：确实要用 `link:` 指着源码目录时，profile 里的依赖名**必须写成包自报的名字** `dsh-session-index`（不能写成 npm 名 `dsh-session-index-lau`）。
> 原因是 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那行 `session-index-host` 的 `name: 'dsh-session-index'` 会按 **profile 的 `node_modules` 目录名**解析；
> 目录叫 `-lau` 时这行解析不到 → 宿主半身不加载 → 面板一片「宿主半身没加载：会话检索面板取不到数」，
> 而 MCP 那行靠 `server-path.txt` 兜底还能跑，很容易误判成索引坏了。
> 反方向是安全的：发版时 `sync-publish.mjs` 会把包名与 patch 行名一起改成 `-lau`，npm 装出来的目录也是 `-lau`，两边一致。

### 方式 C：手动加 MCP（不推荐，仅排障用）

DSH「MCP 与技能」→ MCP 里添加 stdio server：

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 名称 | `session-index` |
| command | `node` 的绝对路径（需 ≥ 22.15） |
| args | `<仓库目录>/server.mjs` |

### 前置条件

1. **Node ≥ 22.15** —— 需要 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`。插件页安装时会自动挑 DSH 自带的 Node（`~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies/node`），通常不用你操心。
2. 方式 B 需要 **pnpm**（DSH 自带）；从 npm registry 拉取，无需 git、无需 SSH key。

### 安装后发生了什么

`cordis.patch.yml` 随 bundle 自动应用，挂两行：`session-index-host`（宿主半身，用 `import.meta.url` 解析真实安装目录，把 `server.mjs` 绝对路径写进 `~/.dsh/session-index/server-path.txt`）与 `mcp-session-index`（MCP stdio 客户端，14 工具 / 4 提示词 / 8 资源）。

三处 `!!js` 表达式在 **DSH 加载配置时求值**（不是安装时），按「显式环境变量 → 宿主记下的路径文件 → profile 标准安装位置」依次探测，因此装到哪个目录都无需改配置，**一次重启即生效**。Skill 与分发包由插件自身在运行时生成。

---

## 插件页装不上？pnpm 排障要点

DSH 插件页装任何东西，底层都是一次 `pnpm install`。装不上时提示常被归类成
「没有写入权限，无法安装」，但**真实原因通常在 pnpm 那一步**。逐项对照排查：

| 检查 | 会导致的现象 |
|---|---|
| Node 支持 zstd | 索引建不起来 |
| git 全局 URL 重写 | 走第三方镜像时 codeload 返回 403 / 认证失败 |
| pnpm `fetch-timeout` | 超过 60000 会让 pnpm 11 直接抛 `UND_ERR_INVALID_ARG`，**所有安装失败** |
| 远端 git 依赖 | 每次安装都要重下，大仓库必然超时 |
| lockfile 残留 `git+ssh` | 仓库已删或缺 SSH key 时必失败 |
| bundle 是否注册 | 插件没被 DSH 加载 |
| 索引状态 | 装完但没建索引 |

### 三个已确认的坑

1. **`fetch-timeout` 有硬上限。** pnpm 11.28 + undici 在 `fetch-timeout > 60000` 时直接报
   `UND_ERR_INVALID_ARG`（实测 60000 正常、65000 就失败）。调大超时不仅没用，还会让所有安装全挂。
2. **大 tarball 装不完。** GitHub 直连在本机约 70–350 KB/s，28 MB 的包需要数分钟，
   永远超不过 60 秒上限，于是 `UND_ERR_DESTROYED` 反复重试直到失败。
   正解不是调超时，而是**把这类依赖本地化**：复制到本地目录，依赖写成 `link:`，
   之后安装完全离线（实测整份 profile 8 秒装完）。
3. **`insteadOf` 镜像规则会连坐。** `url.https://<镜像>/https://github.com/.insteadOf`
   会重写所有 GitHub HTTPS 地址，而镜像一般不代理 `codeload.github.com`（返回 403）。
   直连可用时建议去掉：
   ```bash
   git config --global --get-regexp "url\..*\.insteadof"     # 先看有没有
   git config --global --unset-all "url.https://<镜像前缀>.insteadOf"
   ```

> 本次修复的完整做法（复制包 → `link:` → 离线重建 lockfile）见
> `操作使用手册.html` 第 13 章「排障」。

---

## 装上之后是自动的

| 行为 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 首次建索引 | server 启动时后台子进程构建，**不阻塞 MCP 握手**；未就绪时工具会提示稍候 |
| 新会话识别 | `fs.watch` 递归监听 DSH 与 WorkBuddy 会话目录，写入停止约 3.5 秒后增量纳入 |
| 定时兜底 | 每 60 秒增量刷新，只处理 size/mtime 变化的文件 |
| 安静期保护 | 已有索引的活跃会话需静止 45 秒才重建，避免反复解压正在写入的大文件 |
| 客户端通知 | 索引更新后发 `notifications/resources/list_changed`，客户端无需重启即可感知 |
| 自愈 | 索引缺失或损坏时，下次启动自动重建 |

本机实测（31 个会话）：全量构建 **约 10 秒**、索引 **约 12 MB**（源文件 55 MB+）；
增量刷新 **约 0.85 秒**，无变化时 **约 30 ms**；新会话从写入到可检索 **约 70 ms**。

---

## 工具速览

推荐调用链：`status → brief → related/thread → search → get`，逐级放大，避免一上来灌全文。

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `session_index_status` | 索引与自动维护状态（含监听、下次刷新倒计时） |
| `session_index_brief` | 跨会话结论速览；带 `query` 只取相关主题 |
| `session_index_list` | 会话清单（标题 / 时间 / 工作区 / 应用） |
| `session_index_related` | 相关会话 + 关联理由（共享路径 / 关键词 / 工具 / 血缘 / 同工作区） |
| `session_index_thread` | 父子血缘链（compact 上游、subagent 下游、同源兄弟） |
| `session_index_search` | 语义检索，**只返回命中片段**；默认排除系统注入噪声 |
| `session_index_get` | 先看会话骨架，再按 `seq` 精确取原文 |
| `session_index_remember` | 写入长期记忆（类型 / 标签 / 重要度） |
| `session_index_recall` | 召回长期记忆（时间衰减排序） |
| `session_index_forget` | 归档或删除记忆（默认归档） |
| `session_index_refresh` | 手动增量刷新 |
| `session_index_package` | 重新生成分发包 |
| `session_index_vectors` | 可选的向量索引管理 |
| `session_index_stage` | 会话整理成 Markdown → 思源桥「待入库」（两步确认，绝不自动写库） |

另提供提示词 `session-context` / `resume-topic` / `catch-up` / `quickstart`，
资源 `session-index://guide`、`://plugin.json`、`://status`、`://brief`、`://memory` 等。
`initialize` 会返回 `instructions`，客户端不读外部文档也能正确上手。

**搜索模式**：`semantic`（默认，本地同义词扩展 + BM25，零 token）、`keyword`（精确 AND）、
`hybrid` / `vector`（需配置 embedding，未配置自动降级为本地语义检索）。

## 「会话检索」面板（侧栏）

侧栏图标「会话检索」打开 main 面板：搜索框（300 ms 防抖、Enter 立即搜、Esc 清空）+
会话卡列表（DSH 蓝 / WorkBuddy 黄左色条）+ 右侧详情（结论 / 提问 / 涉及路径 /
关键词点一下直接拿去搜 / 文件 / 工具）。

### 两条数据通道（面板自己选，优先 HTTP）

| 通道 | 谁提供 | 什么时候用 | 依赖 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **本地只读 HTTP**（首选） | **MCP 服务进程**自己开的 `127.0.0.1:8799`（占用就顺延到 8808） | 默认 | 只要 MCP 服务在跑；**不需要会话、不依赖宿主半身** |
| gateway 命令通道（兜底） | 宿主半身注册的 `session-index` 斜杠命令 | HTTP 不通时 | 需要一个活的会话 id + 宿主半身那一行加载成功 |

meta 行右侧会显示当前用的是哪条（`HTTP · 127.0.0.1:8799` / `命令通道`）。
两条都不通时给一句可操作的提示，而不是把网关报错甩给人。

**为什么优先 HTTP**：`commands/execute` 是**按 agent 作用域**的（wire 字段 `agentId`，
类型 SessionId），面板必须先借一个活会话 id 才能被寻址；会话被归档 / 壳重载之后 id 失效，
或者宿主半身那一行没加载（bundle 行名与安装目录名不一致就会这样），面板就整片取不到数。
HTTP 通道把这三层依赖全部去掉，而且**和 agent 用的是同一份索引、同一套查询实现**
（`lib/panel-api.mjs`），所以人和机器搜出来的顺序完全一致。

### 手工验证（不用开面板）

```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/health        # 应返回 {"ok":true,"service":"dsh-session-index","version":"2.9.3"}
curl "http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/list?limit=3"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/search?q=%E6%8F%92%E4%BB%B6"
curl "http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/card?id=<会话id>"
```

端口记在 `~/.dsh/session-index/http-url.txt`（MCP 服务每次启动刷新）。
接口**只绑 127.0.0.1**：读接口 `GET/HEAD`；写操作只有两处 ——
`POST /api/sync/*`（同步模块，必须带 `X-Session-Index-Sync` 头）与 `POST /api/diag`（面板自诊断）。
不返回会话原文，只返回会话卡。
**跨源按源判定**：公网站点与局域网不给 CORS 头；**本机来源放行**（回环、本机主机名、
`.localhost/.local/.internal` 等后缀、`dsh-app://` `file://` 这类自定义 scheme），
需要额外放行时把 Origin 填进 `SESSION_INDEX_HTTP_ALLOW_ORIGIN`。
每次请求都记在 `~/.dsh/session-index/http-access.log`（时间 / 方法 / 路径 / Origin / 状态码）。

### 面板失效怎么查（三份日志，都在 `~/.dsh/session-index/`）

面板在**浏览器**里跑，它拿到的是数据还是被挡住，宿主机本来是看不见的 ——
所以插件专门留了三份自诊断文件。**先打开一次面板，再看这三份**：

| 文件 | 说明什么 | 怎么看 |
|---|---|---|
| `client-diagnostics.log` | **面板自己报的失败原因**：两条通道各试了什么、错在哪 | 看最后一条 `failures` 数组，里面逐条写了「HTTP 通道：…」「命令通道：…」 |
| `http-access.log` | 面板**到底请求了什么**、Origin 是什么、拿到什么状态码 | 有 `/api/list` 且 `status=200` → 服务端没问题；**没有它** → 请求没发出去或被探活超时掐了；`status=403` → 被跨源策略挡了（看 `origin=` 值） |
| `host-half.log` | 宿主半身有没有加载、命令有没有注册 | 没有 `apply` 行 = 那一行压根没被 DSH 加载；有 `apply` 没 `command registered` = `commands` 服务没就位 |

**一个已修的典型根因（v2.9.3）**：同步模块用 `execFileSync` 跑 git → **阻塞整个 MCP 进程**，
面板探活（`/api/health`）超时 → 报「没有找到本地服务」→ 面板空白。
特征是 `http-access.log` 里**面板的 health 请求被排到几秒之后才记录**（排队等 git 结束）。
现在 git 全异步，慢远端在后台跑，面板 6ms 内就有响应。

**跨源被挡**（`http-access.log` 里 `status=403` 或浏览器报 CORS 错）：
渲染进程的 `origin=` 若是本机地址应已放行；还不行就把那个 Origin 填进
`SESSION_INDEX_HTTP_ALLOW_ORIGIN`（见 `cordis.patch.yml`，逗号分隔、`*` 为全放行）。

**宿主半身没加载**（`client-diagnostics.log` 的 failures 里出现这句话）：
查 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `session-index-host` 的 `name` 与 profile `node_modules` 里的**目录名**
是否一致 —— `link:` 安装时必须用包自报名 `dsh-session-index`（见上文「本地迭代例外」）。

## 跨终端同步（面板 → 私有数据仓）

把**会话卡 + 长期记忆**推到一个 GitHub **Private** 仓；另一台装了本插件的机器拉取合并后，
也能搜到这台机器的历史结论与记忆。功能本身（插件、技能、面板、14 个工具）**不需要同步** ——
它们随插件安装走，另一终端 `pnpm add` / 插件页安装即得。

### 面板四步

1. 面板 meta 行右侧点 **「同步」**；
2. 远端地址**通常不用填** —— 它按「环境变量 → 本机已保存 → 包内默认」三级解析
   （包内 `sync.default.json` 带着默认仓地址，所以新机器装上就知道跟谁同步）；
   要换成别的仓再填 → **保存地址**；
3. **上传到远端**（本机 → 仓）；
4. 另一台机器装好插件 → 它会**首启自动拉一次**（本地一张会话卡都没有时才拉，不会覆盖本机数据），
   面板顶部也会出现「远端有新数据（N 张会话卡）」横幅，点一下即合并。

不想让地址随包公开就删掉包里的 `sync.default.json`（会退回面板里手填）；
某台机器明确不接默认地址：设 `SESSION_INDEX_SYNC_NO_DEFAULT=1`。

也可以不走 git：**导出 zip** 生成 `~/.dsh/session-index/exports/session-index-data-<时间>.zip`，
拷到另一台机器用「导入合并」打开（同样是合并，不会覆盖那边的新数据）。

### 另一台终端拉取之后，agent 怎么用

同步过来的是**会话卡 + 长期记忆**（不含会话原文），工具侧已经适配：

| 工具 | 同步来的会话怎么表现 |
|---|---|
| `session_index_brief` | 正常返回这些会话的**结论 / 提问 / 关键词** ✔ |
| `session_index_search` | 会话卡也进召回集（标题+提问+结论+关键词），**同步来的内容搜得到** ✔ |
| `session_index_list` | 会列出它们，并标 `imported: true`（本机没有原文） ✔ |
| `session_index_get` | 本机没原文时返回 `mode: "card"`：结论 / 提问 / 涉及路径 / 关键词（不是报错） ✔ |
| `session_index_recall` | 同步来的**长期记忆**照常召回 ✔ |
| `session_index_get` 取原文 | ✘ 原文不同步 —— 要看原文得去产生它的那台机器 |

> 一句话：**另一台终端装上插件、拉完数据，agent 立刻就能用上这边的历史结论与记忆**；
> 只有「逐句原文」这一层拿不到 —— 那是刻意不传的（几十 MB 且含隐私）。

### 同步范围与合并语义

| | 内容 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **同步** | `cards.json` 会话卡、`notes.json` 长期记忆 | 几百 KB；另一终端可 `brief / search / related / card` + 记忆召回 |
| **不同步** | 记录分片 `*.jsonl.gz`（会话原文） | 几十 MB 且含隐私；另一终端 `get` 取不到原文是**取舍不是缺陷** |
| **不同步** | `meta.json`、`host-half.log`、`sync.json`、`sync-remote/` | 本机派生数据 / 本机状态 |

**合并，绝不覆盖**：同 id 取 `updatedAt` 更新的那份；两边独有的都保留；记忆再按「类型 + 文本」
去重一次（两台机器各自 `remember` 同一句话不会变成两条），标签取并集、重要度取最大。
push 与 pull 是**同一个 union 合并**，区别只是最后要不要把结果推上去。

**幂等**：进仓的文件做了规范化（对象键递归排序、记忆排序、抹掉本机时间戳），
所以「同样的数据 → 同样的字节」，重复推送是 `changed: false`，两台机器不会互相追着时间戳提交。

### 手工验证 / 排障

```bash
curl -H "X-Session-Index-Sync: 1" http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/sync/status
curl -X POST -H "X-Session-Index-Sync: 1" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"repo":"git@github.com:你/dsh-session-index-data.git"}' http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/sync/config
curl -X POST -H "X-Session-Index-Sync: 1" -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/sync/push
curl -X POST -H "X-Session-Index-Sync: 1" -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:8799/api/sync/pull
```

- **没有 git**：接口会明说「这台机器没有 git 命令」；装 git 即可。
- **认证失败 / Repository not found**：SSH key 没加到 GitHub，或仓不是 Private / 还没创建。
- **远端没有数据**：先在一台机器点「上传」。
- **挂起**：不会 —— git 一律 `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` + `BatchMode=yes`，需要交互时直接报错退出，
  绝不把 MCP 进程吊在那等输入。

### 写接口的防护

`/api/sync/*` 是本插件**唯一会写盘/调 git** 的一组接口，三道闸：

1. 只绑 `127.0.0.1`；
2. **Origin 按源判定**（远程 http(s) 网站不给 CORS 头，预检直接 403）；
3. **必须带 `X-Session-Index-Sync: 1` 头** —— 自定义头强制浏览器先发预检，
   远程网页的 `no-cors` 简单请求到不了服务端（否则能被网页偷偷触发拉取）。

`import` 只接受 `exports/` 目录下的 zip，不给借道读任意路径。

## 会话整理 → 思源桥「待入库」

`session_index_stage` 把索引里的会话卡、结论、检索片段整理成一篇 Markdown，**投递到思源桥的待入库队列**。
它只做「投递」这一步，**绝不调用 `/api/stage/commit`**——写进思源笔记库永远由你在思源桥界面点确认。

### 为什么不用再做一个插件

DSH 的插件之间**不共享会话数据**：会话本体只有一份磁盘文件，各插件各自解析、各自维护私有目录。
但会话卡与结论已经在 `session-index` 手里，而思源桥是独立的 HTTP 服务（默认 `127.0.0.1:5599`），
所以一次 HTTP 调用就能对接，不需要 DSH 内核级的插件通信，更不需要第三个插件重新解一遍 zstd。

### 三步用法

```text
1) 只读探测（可选）
   session_index_stage { "status": true }
   → 返回思源桥内核版本、队列篇数、自动接入目录

2) 预览（默认，不产生任何写入）
   session_index_stage { "query": "插件", "template": "brief", "limit": 5 }
   → 返回 title / chars / preview / token / target / confirmWith

3) 用户看过预览、点头后，把 confirmWith 原样回传
   session_index_stage { ...confirmWith }
   → 投递到「待入库」；返回 id 与落点
```

第 2 步**永远只是预览**。第 3 步的 `confirmToken` 绑定了「标题 + 落点 + 正文」，
参数被改动或索引刚更新导致内容变化时令牌失配，会直接拒绝投递并要求重新预览——不会出现「预览 A、投递 B」。

### 主要参数

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | false | 只读探测服务与队列，不做任何写入 |
| `query` | 空 | 主题词，按主题聚合会话 |
| `sessionIds` | 空 | 精确指定会话 id（支持前缀），不传则取最近/相关会话 |
| `app` / `workspace` / `since` / `until` | all / 空 | 范围过滤 |
| `template` | `brief` | `brief` 速览 / `decisions` 只要结论 / `detail` 附检索片段 |
| `title` | 自动生成 | 自定义文档标题（确认时回传预览给出的值） |
| `hpath` / `notebook` | `/会话札记/思源` / `思源桥` | 落点；**写入前仍可在思源桥界面改** |
| `note` / `limit` / `maxChars` | 自动 / 8 / 12000 | 备注、会话数、篇幅上限 |
| `confirmToken` | 空 | 预览返回的令牌；带上且匹配才真正投递 |

### 环境变量

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `SIYUAN_BRIDGE_PORT` / `SIYUAN_BRIDGE_URL` | `5599` / `http://127.0.0.1:5599` | 服务地址；**只允许回环地址**，不接受任意内网 URL |
| `SESSION_INDEX_STAGE` | `1` | 设 `0` 彻底禁用该工具 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_STAGE_TIMEOUT_MS` | `5000` | 单次请求超时（1000–60000） |
| `SESSION_INDEX_STAGE_HPATH` / `_NOTEBOOK` | `/会话札记/思源` / `思源桥` | 默认落点 |

### 安全边界

- 只调用 `/api/status`、`/api/stage`（GET/POST）、`/api/autostage`，**不调用 commit**
- 投递前按「标题 + 字数」查队列，已有同稿则不重复入队
- 服务不可达时返回结构化错误（`BRIDGE_UNREACHABLE`），不抛堆栈、不影响其它 13 个工具
- 文档硬上限 60000 字；Markdown 里明确标注「未写入笔记库」

> 实测提醒：思源桥 `/api/autostage` 返回的实际 `session-docs` 目录可能与 `config.json` 里的
> `dataDir` 不一致（服务走 `SIYUAN_BRIDGE_DATA` 推导）。本工具走 HTTP 接口，不受这个差异影响。

### 推送已有文档（手册 / README）

`session_index_stage` 整理的是**索引里的会话**；如果要把仓库里现成的文档送进待入库，
用独立脚本 `tools/push-doc.mjs`（不需要重启 DSH、不依赖 MCP 服务）：

```bash
node tools/push-doc.mjs                                   # 只读预览《操作使用手册.html》
node tools/push-doc.mjs --send                            # 投递到待入库（绝不写库）
node tools/push-doc.mjs --file README.md --dry            # 推别的文件
node tools/push-doc.mjs --hpath "/会话札记/运维" --send    # 指定落点
```

**批量：WorkBuddy 所有会话生成的文档**

```bash
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy                  # 只列清单（默认，零写入）
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy --send           # 全部投递到待入库
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy --no-exclude     # 连临时/备份目录一起
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy --include-txt    # 连 .txt 一起
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy --source PresentFiles --limit 10 --send
node tools/push-doc.mjs --from-workbuddy --seed         # 只记状态基线，不投递任何文档
```

数据源是 `~/.workbuddy/artifact-index/<会话id>.json` 里 `contentType: document` 的条目
（`WORKBUDDY_ARTIFACT_INDEX` 可改）。默认会**排除** `node_modules/dist/.git`、`.verify-*`、
`DSH-probe`、旧开发副本 `dsh-session-index`、备份与 UI 源码，并按**内容哈希 + 路径**去重，
避免同一份 README 被推十几遍。每篇标题带相对路径、备注带来源会话，落点统一可在界面改。

实测（2026-11-14）：70 条文档命中 → 排除 26 条临时/依赖 → 文件已不存在 4 →
路径或内容重复 18 → **唯一 22 篇全部投递成功**，队列 23 篇（含此前单推的手册）。
可用 `--limit`（默认 60）与 `--since` 收窄。

**判重：对齐思源桥 `autoStage` 的 `.auto-staged.json`，但丢弃后不重新获取。**

状态文件 `~/.dsh/session-index/push-doc-state.json`（`PUSH_DOC_STATE` 可改）按
「文档路径 + 内容 sha256」记录已推送过的文档，**判重不看队列里还在不在**：

- 在思源桥里「丢弃」某篇 → 下次自动化**不会**把它重新推送回来
- 队列被清空、服务重启、定时任务重跑 → 同样不会重复入队
- 内容真的改了 → 作为新版本投递一次，之后又不再重复
- `--force` 可强制绕过；`--seed` 只写状态基线、不投递（首次启用或迁移时用）

- **默认只预览**，加 `--send` 才入队；预览写到 `dist/push-doc-preview.md`
- HTML 会先裁掉侧栏导航、复制按钮、脚本、样式与统计卡，再用思源桥自带的
  `/api/paste/html`（只读）转成 Markdown，不会把界面文字塞进笔记
- 同样**只入队、不 commit**，写入仍由你在思源桥界面确认

### 插件怎么更新（DSH 插件页有没有「更新」按钮）

**有，但只对特定安装来源显示**，这是 DSH 插件页的规则（从 DSH 内置文档确认）：

| 安装来源 | 更新方式 |
|---|---|
| 注册表（npm）安装的第三方组合包 | 详情页有「版本」区块与**更新**按钮，可查新版本并升级 |
| Git 仓库安装的组合包（`update: 'git'`） | 通过「发现」页 / 详情页的**更新到**升级 |
| 官方按需插件 | 有显式**更新**（版本或开发链接来源不同时） |
| **本地路径 / `link:` / 压缩包安装的** | **不显示版本区块**，文档写明「通过卸载后重新安装升级」 |

**本机当前是 npm registry 来源**（2026-11-18 v2.9.3 发布后切回）：profile 依赖是
`"dsh-session-index-lau": "^2.9.3"`，属于上表第一行 —— 插件页**有「版本」区块与「更新」按钮**，
以后发新版后**点更新即可，不需要卸载重装**；命令行 `pnpm update dsh-session-index-lau` 与点按钮同一条路。

> ⚠ 切回 npm 后，改本机代码**不再即时生效**：要走「改仓库 → 发布 npm → 插件页更新 →
> 完全退出 DSH 再打开」。想边改边看效果时，把 profile 依赖临时指回源码目录
> （`"dsh-session-index": "link:<源码目录>"` + bundles 同名 + 删掉 `-lau` 那条），
> 但**依赖名必须用包自报名**，否则 bundle patch 里 `session-index-host` 那一行解析不到，
> 宿主半身不加载、面板会假死（详见上文「本地迭代例外」与「面板报宿主半身没加载怎么办」）。

发布侧走**随仓库走的**标准流程（`tools/publish/`，三个插件共用同一套工具）：

```bash
cd tools/publish
node sync-publish.mjs session-index                       # ④ 生成改名后的发布副本并自检
node check-release.mjs session-index --pre                # ④.5 发布前门禁（未全绿禁止发布）
cd <副本根>/dsh-session-index-lau && npm publish --access public
# 等 npm staged publishing 生效（实测 1~8 分钟）
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && npx -y pnpm@11.28.5 update dsh-session-index-lau@<新版本>
node check-release.mjs session-index --post               # ⑧ 安装后核验（版本四处统一 + MCP 握手）
```

完整流程见 [`tools/publish/插件发布标准流程.md`](./tools/publish/插件发布标准流程.md)；
换机器时复制 `tools/publish/config.example.json` 为 `config.local.json` 改路径即可，
**脚本一行都不用改**（路径解析见 `tools/publish/paths.mjs`）。

注意 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` 要同步登记新版本，
否则供应链冷却期会让 pnpm 静默回退旧版。更新后**完全退出 DSH 再打开**，
运行中的 MCP 子进程才会换成新版。

> 只有从本地路径 / `link:` / 压缩包安装的才没有更新按钮（需卸载重装）；
> 这类挂载因为直接指向仓库目录，`git pull` + 重启即生效，同样不用重装。
> 发布给别人用需要 `git push` + `npm publish`；本机开发目录则 `git pull` 即可。

---

## 更新 / 校验 / 回滚

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm update dsh-session-index-lau       # 升级（先在 pnpm-workspace.yaml 登记 包名@精确版本 豁免供应链冷却期）
pnpm remove dsh-session-index-lau       # 卸载
```

源仓库开发时的自检命令：

```bash
node pack.mjs                    # 重新生成插件包 + 技能包
node build-index.mjs --force     # 全量重建索引
node smoke.mjs                   # 端到端自测（含标准形态断言）
```

---

## 分发包（离线 / 无 git 环境）

`node pack.mjs` 可随时重新生成（打包由 `lib/pack.mjs` 完成，纯 Node 零依赖）：

| 文件 | 内容 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `dist/dsh-session-index-v2.9.3.zip` | 全部源码 + 清单 + 文档 + 手册 + 脚本 + `MANIFEST.json` + `INSTALL.md` | 完整分发，按标准流程 `pnpm add` 安装 |
| `dist/session-index-skill-v2.9.3.zip` | 根 `SKILL.md` + 说明 | 直接导入 DSH「MCP 与技能」 |

包内**排除**：索引分片 `*.jsonl.gz`、`meta/cards/notes/vectors.json`、备份与临时文件、已有 zip。
已验证包内无任何会话数据与密钥，可安全分发。也可调 MCP 工具 `session_index_package` 触发打包。

---

## 配置项

全部通过配置块的 `env` 设置。改哪里取决于安装方式：

- **插件页安装**：改插件包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-index/cordis.patch.yml`），改完重启 DSH；
- **pnpm 安装**：改已装包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-index-lau/cordis.patch.yml`）里的 `env`；升级会还原默认值，如需长期自定义建议用环境变量。

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO` | `1` | 总开关，`0` 关闭后台自动维护 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS` | `60000` | 定时增量刷新间隔（最小 15000） |
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO_QUIET_MS` | `45000` | 已有会话的静止期（活跃时不重建） |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH` | `1` | 文件事件监听开关 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS` | `3500` | 写入事件防抖 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH_QUIET_MS` | `6000` | 监听路径的静止期 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_APPS` | `all` | 只索引 `dsh` 或 `workbuddy` |
| `SESSION_INDEX_DIR` | `~/.dsh/session-index` | 索引产物目录 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_EMBED_URL` / `_MODEL` / `_KEY` | 空 | 可选，OpenAI 兼容 embedding；不配则纯本地 |

> 环境变量方式优先级最高，且升级不会覆盖，推荐用它替代改包内文件。

---

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-session-index/                  # 仓库根 = 插件根
├── server.mjs                      # MCP stdio server（14 工具 / prompts / resources）
├── cordis.patch.yml                # bundle patch：挂宿主行 + MCP 行（含 !!js 自解析路径）
├── build-index.mjs                 # 索引构建（多帧 zstd → 可检索记录 + 会话卡）
├── pack.mjs                        # 打包 CLI（零依赖 ZIP writer）
├── smoke.mjs                       # 98 项端到端自测
├── test-panel.mjs                  # 面板 + 本地 HTTP 通道 91 项单测
├── test-sync.mjs                   # 跨终端同步 40 项单测（本地裸仓当远端，不联网）
├── icon.svg                        # 插件页图标（package.json 的 icon 字段指向它）
├── plugin.json                     # 机器可读能力清单（也通过 MCP 资源暴露）
├── package.json                    # 元信息 + dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.plugin 声明
├── 操作使用手册.html                # 自包含单页手册（14 章）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.mjs                   # 宿主半身：解析自身安装路径 + 斜杠命令 + 自诊断日志
│   ├── client.js                   # 浏览器半身：侧栏「会话检索」面板（HTTP 优先、命令兜底、同步模块）
│   ├── panel-api.mjs               # 面板 / 斜杠命令 / HTTP 共用的查询实现（唯一口径）
│   ├── http-api.mjs                # 本地只读 HTTP + /api/sync/*（面板主通道，127.0.0.1:8799 起）
│   ├── sync.mjs                    # 跨终端同步：合并语义 + git 推拉 + 本地 zip 导入导出
│   ├── reader.mjs                  # 多帧 zstd 读取
│   ├── extract.mjs                 # 事件 → 文本记录（含系统注入降噪）
│   ├── cards.mjs                   # 会话卡 / 关联度 / 血缘
│   ├── index-store.mjs             # 分片存储与增量签名
│   ├── source-workbuddy.mjs        # WorkBuddy 会话适配器
│   ├── semantic.mjs                # 同义词扩展 + BM25
│   ├── embedding.mjs               # 可选向量检索
│   ├── notes.mjs                   # 长期记忆库
│   ├── auto.mjs                    # 自动建索引 / 定时刷新
│   ├── watch.mjs                   # 文件事件监听
│   ├── pack.mjs                    # ZIP writer
│   └── stage.mjs                   # 会话整理 → 思源桥待入库（渲染 + HTTP 投递）
├── skill/SKILL.md                  # 自动接入用技能
├── tools/push-doc.mjs             # 推送任意 md/html 到思源桥待入库（默认只读预览）
├── tools/publish/                 # 跨插件共用的发布工具链（随仓库走版本，见其 README）
│   ├── 插件发布标准流程.md          # 完整发布流程 ①→⑨
│   ├── sync-publish.mjs           # ④ 同步 npm 发布副本（改名 + 发布化 + 自检）
│   ├── check-release.mjs          # ④.5 / ⑧ 发布核验门禁
│   ├── update-plugin.mjs          # ⑦ 安装更新助手
│   └── paths.mjs                  # 路径解析（换机器改 config.local.json 即可）
└── dist/                           # 自动生成的分发包（git 忽略）
```

索引产物写入 `~/.dsh/session-index/`，**与仓库目录分离**，所以换 clone 位置不会丢索引。

---

## 隐私与安全

- **源会话只读**：任何操作都不修改 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 与 `~/.workbuddy/projects/` 下的原始文件。
- **配置写前备份**：每次改 `cordis.patch.yml` 都先复制为 `.bak-<时间戳>`。
- **不入库**：索引、长期记忆、备份、验证产物均在 `.gitignore` 中排除。
- **索引含会话原文**：`~/.dsh/session-index/` 是会话全文的本地副本，**不要打包外传**；分发请用 `dist/` 里的 zip（已自动排除）。

---

## 卸载

- **插件页安装的**：插件页里禁用或卸载 `dsh-session-index`，重启 DSH 即可（MCP 行随 bundle 一起消失）。
- **pnpm 安装的**：`pnpm remove dsh-session-index-lau`，或在插件页禁用 / 卸载；MCP 行随 bundle 一起消失。

两种情况下索引目录 `~/.dsh/session-index/` 都保留（不影响原始会话），需要时手动删除。

---

## 变更记录

| 版本 | 变更 |
|---|---|
| **v2.8.0** | 新增**跨终端同步**（面板「同步」模块 + `lib/sync.mjs` + `/api/sync/*`）：把**会话卡 + 长期记忆**推到 GitHub **Private** 数据仓，另一台终端拉取合并即可继续搜到历史结论；**不同步会话原文分片**（取舍，已写明）。合并是 union（同 id 取新、两边独有都保留、记忆按类型+文本去重、标签取并集），**绝不覆盖**；进仓字节做规范化（键排序 + 抹掉本机时间戳），重复推送 `changed: false`，两台机器不会互相追着时间戳提交。面板另有**本地导出 / 导入 zip**（不走 git 的手动搬运）。写接口三道闸：只绑回环 + Origin 按源判定 + 必须带 `X-Session-Index-Sync` 头（堵 `no-cors` CSRF），`import` 只认 `exports/` 目录。新增 `test-sync.mjs` 40 项（本地裸仓当远端，A推→B拉→B推→A拉双向验证）；`smoke` 93 → 98。 |

| **v2.6.0** | 新增**「会话检索」面板**（侧栏入口 + main 面板）：搜索框 + 会话卡列表（DSH 蓝 / WorkBuddy 黄左色条）+ 右侧详情（结论 · 提问 · 涉及路径 · 关键词 · 工具）。数据走宿主半身注册的 `session-index` 命令（`ctx.remote.commands.execute`），**浏览器半身不碰文件系统**；宿主半身没加载时给一句人话提示而不是静默失败。新增 `test-panel.mjs`（57 项），版本一致性改为跟 `package.json` 对齐 |

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Triage Desk

[![check](https://github.com/LHCWN/dsh-triage-desk/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/LHCWN/dsh-triage-desk/actions/workflows/check.yml)
[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-triage-desk.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-triage-desk)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)
plugin that answers one question every morning: **what needs me right now?** It
turns GitHub activity into a single inbox panel: reviews waiting on you, your
merge-ready PRs, threads that need an answer, failing CI, and new or assigned
issues. One click opens a coding agent on any item with a prepared prompt that
you review before sending. Everything runs locally through the GitHub CLI; the
plugin never stores or forwards a token.

[简体中文](README.zh.md) · [Reference](docs/REFERENCE.md) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## What it shows

- **Waiting for your review**: PRs that request your review (directly or through a team) at a head you have not reviewed.
- **Re-review needed**: PRs with new commits since your review, a re-request, or an author reply to you.
- **Ready to merge**: your approved, mergeable PRs; by default only with green checks.
- **Needs your action**: requested changes, conflicts, reviewer comments, assigned issues, and unanswered mentions.
- **CI is failing**: red checks on your PRs, on default branches you maintain, and on branches whose latest commit you authored in the last week.
- **New in your repositories**: unassigned issues from the last 30 days, kept out of the attention counter.
- **Snooze**: per row, per section, or a selection, until new activity, tomorrow, or next week.
- **Launch scenarios**: named, editable prompts that open a coding agent in the local clone or a new DSH chat.
- **Agent tool**: `triage_desk` gives a DSH agent the same snapshot and can open a terminal on request.
- **Sources and languages**: personal repositories plus up to 10 organizations; the panel follows the DSH language (English or Chinese).

Each feature is described in full in the [reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#inbox).

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.2-rc.2` or newer.
- **GitHub only**: GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, and other code hosts are not supported.
- The GitHub CLI installed and signed in (`gh auth login`). Private repositories
  need the `repo` scope that `gh auth login` normally grants. Settings shows the
  connection and has a **Sign in to GitHub** button.
- Optional, for typing prompts into agents other than Claude Code: Python 3 on
  macOS and Linux, Windows 10 version 1809 or later on Windows (see
  [prompt delivery](docs/REFERENCE.md#prompt-delivery)).

## Install

Triage Desk is a DSH **bundle**: DSH installs it into a profile and loads it as a
plugin. There is no build step.

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-triage-desk
```

`<profile>` is the profile you run: `web` for `dsh web`, `desktop` for the
Desktop app. Restart DSH, refresh the page, and open the **Triage** entry in the
sidebar. The first run auto-detects your organizations; the gear in the header
changes them. Plugin Manager can also install the package by name.

To update later, run the following and restart DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-triage-desk@latest
```

### From a local checkout (development)

1. Clone the repository.
2. In DSH open **Plugins → Add plugin** and pick the repository directory, or run
   `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-triage-desk` from its parent folder.
3. Open the **Triage** entry in the sidebar.

After editing the host half, quit and reopen DSH, then refresh the page; see
[local development](docs/DEV_LOCAL.md) for the reload rules.

## Launching agents

The terminal button on a row (or a section header) opens the launch menu: pick a
target (**DSH — this app** or an installed agent), then a scenario. A row
scenario opens the agent in the repository's local clone; a section scenario
launches one agent with the list of every visible row. The prompt is always
prepared but **not sent**. A line under the agent picker says where it opens and
how the prompt arrives, for example *Opens in Ghostty · prompt typed into the
input box, unsent*.

**Terminals.** Settings → *Terminal and agents* → **Open agents in** offers
*Automatic* or one of this platform's terminals; terminals that are not installed
are shown disabled.

| Platform | Terminals | Automatic |
|---|---|---|
| macOS | Terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty | iTerm2 when installed, otherwise Terminal |
| Linux | GNOME Terminal, Konsole, Xfce Terminal, Ghostty, kitty, Alacritty, xterm | `$TERMINAL`, then the first installed emulator |
| Windows | Windows Terminal, PowerShell window | Windows Terminal when installed |

iTerm2, Ghostty (macOS), GNOME Terminal, Konsole, Xfce Terminal, and Windows
Terminal open a tab; the others open a window per launch. A saved terminal that
is not installed falls back to Automatic, and the launch toast says so.

**Prompt delivery.** Claude Code always opens with the prompt as its native
`--prefill` draft. For every other agent, Settings → **Prompt delivery** offers:

- **Type into the agent** (default, recommended): a small paste wrapper waits
  until the agent's input box is ready, then pastes the prompt into it without
  pressing Enter. Needs Python 3 on macOS (`xcode-select --install`) and Linux,
  or Windows 10 1809 or later; without it, launches use the clipboard and
  Settings and the toast say how to fix it.
- **Copy to clipboard**: the agent opens empty and you paste the prompt
  (⌘V on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+V in Linux terminals, Ctrl+V on Windows).

The toast names the agent and the terminal, for example *Codex opened in Ghostty
(/path): the prompt will appear in its input box, not sent — review it and press
Enter*.

**Agents.** Built-in presets cover Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor Agent, Antigravity (`agy`), and pi; **Find agents** in Settings also
detects Aider, Amp, Droid, Goose, and Crush, and you can add your own command. A
command must contain `{prompt}` exactly once, unquoted, as its own argument or
right after a `--flag=`.

Details: [terminal launcher reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#terminal-launcher).

## Settings

The gear in the panel header opens Settings. The most used fields:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `orgs` | `[]` | Organizations to scan (at most 10); empty auto-detects them |
| `includePersonal` | `true` | Include your personal repositories |
| `refreshSeconds` | `1200` | Auto-refresh interval, 15–3600 s |
| `requireGreenChecks` | `true` | *Ready to merge* only with green or no checks |
| `defaultAgent` | `claude` | Agent selected in the launch menu |
| `terminal` | `auto` | Terminal for launches: `auto` or a terminal id |
| `promptDelivery` | `paste` | `paste` (type into the agent) or `clipboard` |

All fields, including agents, scenarios, and clone search, are in the
[configuration reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#configuration).

## Development

```sh
npm install     # dev dependencies and the pre-commit hook
npm run check   # lint, docs links, and all offline smokes
```

`npm run smoke:host` is a live check against GitHub that spends quota, so it is
not part of `npm run check`. Smokes, layout, and releasing:
[reference](docs/REFERENCE.md#development); module map:
[architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-deskpet

A DSH Host plugin for a PySide6 desktop pet. The Host owns one Python child
process; the two sides exchange newline-delimited JSON over stdin/stdout. The
pet includes a small chat dialog whose replies use the DSH-configured model.
Credentials stay owned by DSH: the plugin reads no key files and starts no
second Harness.

The current local installation candidate is **0.2.1-rc.2**. See
[`docs/INSTALL.md`](./docs/INSTALL.md) for setup, diagnostics, settings, and data
handling. Release artifacts are produced by `npm run release:check`.

## Files

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`index.js`](./index.js) | Cordis Host plugin, child-process lifecycle, JSON protocol, logging |
| [`config.js`](./config.js), [`python-runtime.js`](./python-runtime.js) | Real Schemastery settings schema and portable interpreter discovery |
| [`scripts/setup.ps1`](./scripts/setup.ps1), [`scripts/doctor.ps1`](./scripts/doctor.ps1) | Isolated Python environment installation and read-only diagnosis |
| [`python/deskpet_bridge.py`](./python/deskpet_bridge.py) | Python test peer: `ping` → `pong`, `shutdown` → `bye`, task-state and chat routing |
| [`python/pet_windows.py`](./python/pet_windows.py) | Desktop-pet window: frameless always-on-top robot plus the chat dialog |
| [`requirements.txt`](./requirements.txt) | Pinned UI dependency (`PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0`) |
| [`python/pet.py`](./python/pet.py) | Legacy stdin/stdout test peer (not spawned by the plugin) |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml) | Bundle patch that inserts the `deskpet` row and configures Python |
| [`package.json`](./package.json) | Bundle manifest (`dsh.bundle.patch`) and exports |
| [`tests/bridge-smoke.mjs`](./tests/bridge-smoke.mjs) | Host-contract smoke test using a mock `ctx` |
| [`tests/chat-host-smoke.mjs`](./tests/chat-host-smoke.mjs) | Direct-model chat smoke test with mock `llm`/`agentDefaultModel` services |
| [`tests/chat-ui-smoke.py`](./tests/chat-ui-smoke.py) | Offscreen chat-dialog smoke test (submit, reply, failure, long text) |
| [`test.mjs`](./test.mjs) | Legacy manual protocol test (not part of the automated suite) |
| [`locale/en.json`](./locale/en.json), [`locale/zh.json`](./locale/zh.json) | Plugin title and description |
| [`icon.svg`](./icon.svg) | Original plugin icon |

## Interface verification against this installation

Verified against the Desktop runtime that loaded this plugin:

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Desktop runtime package | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime` **0.2.2-rc.3** |
| Host framework | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` **4.1.0** |
| Node used by the runtime | **24.21.0** |
| Python used in local verification | **3.14.6**, including a fresh isolated environment |
| PySide6 | **6.12.0** (Essentials) |

The specific interfaces used were read from the installed runtime:

- **Function plugin shape:** `Plugin.Function` is `(ctx, config) => any`; an
  async function is valid.
- **Cleanup ownership:** `ctx.effect(execute, label)` runs `execute`
  immediately, collects its returned disposer, and runs it when the fiber
  unloads.
- **Activation timing:** `apply()` waits for the startup `pong` before the
  fiber becomes active, so an `active` row is evidence that the real bridge
  completed ping/pong.
- **Bundle format:** `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; the patch
  inserts row `deskpet`. Installed with `plugin_manager` `install_bundle`,
  which returned `application: "applied"`.
- **Model access:** replies use the existing DSH `llm` service with the route
  from `agentDefaultModel`; the plugin reads no credential and needs no second
  API key.
- **Session boundary:** chat and memory live in the plugin's own files; no DSH
  session is created or written.

Configuration is exposed through the real Schemastery `Config` from
[`config.js`](./config.js), pinned to the installed Host's version 3.18.5.
The native Cordis `resolveConfig()` contract is verified; runtime normalization
also validates paired model overrides and resolves a blank Python path.

## Protocol

One JSON object per line, in both directions. Python stdout is protocol-only;
Python diagnostics go to stderr and are forwarded to the Host logger with a
`[python]` prefix.

Host → Python:

```json
{"type":"ping","id":1,"reason":"startup","sentAt":"2026-10-31T13:30:00.000Z"}
{"type":"ping","id":2,"reason":"heartbeat","sentAt":"2026-10-31T13:30:15.000Z"}
{"type":"shutdown","id":3}
```

Python → Host:

```json
{"type":"ready"}
{"type":"pong","id":1,"pid":12345,"echo":"2026-10-31T13:30:00.000Z"}
{"type":"bye","id":3,"pid":12345}
```

Startup rules:

1. Spawn Python with pipes for stdin/stdout/stderr.
2. Wait for the OS `spawn` event.
3. Send `ping` with a fresh id and wait for the matching `pong`.
4. Only then let `apply()` resolve; start the heartbeat.
5. On unload, send `shutdown`, close stdin, wait up to
   `shutdownTimeoutMs`, then terminate the process if necessary. `stop()` is
   idempotent.

A non-JSON or non-object stdout line is logged as a warning and never treated
as a pong, so a stray debug `print()` cannot accidentally satisfy the
handshake.

### Task state and chat

These lines reuse the same request/response protocol after the handshake; they
do not change startup or shutdown:

```json
{"type":"pet.state","state":"thinking"}
{"type":"pet.state","state":"thinking","result":{"id":1,"state":"done"}}
{"type":"pet.state","state":"idle","result":{"id":1,"state":"done"}}
{"type":"chat","id":7,"text":"帮我看看 README"}
```

```json
{"type":"chat/accepted","id":7}
{"type":"chat/reply","id":7,"text":"README 主要讲了协议和安装步骤……","reason":"completed"}
{"type":"chat/error","id":7,"message":"模型调用失败的原因"}
{"type":"chat/history","entries":[{"role":"user","text":"…","time":"2026-11-05T09:00:00+08:00"}]}
{"type":"chat/memory","count":12,"updatedAt":"2026-11-05T09:00:00+08:00"}
{"type":"chat/memory/details","id":1,"revision":0,"enabled":true,"items":[{"id":"…","kind":"preference","text":"喜欢青色"}]}
{"type":"chat/memory/error","id":1,"message":"记忆保存失败，原条目已保留"}
```

`pet.state` follows live `agent/status` events (`{ agent, status }`):
`running` maps to `thinking`; once every observed agent is `idle` (or disposed),
the activity returns to `idle`. On activation,
`agents.list()` seeds agents already running; updates received before the Python
handshake are coalesced and sent after it. Duplicate states do not restart the
animation, and unloading removes the subscriptions. Agent instances are tracked
separately so disposing an old instance cannot clear a replacement's busy state.
`session/event` provides results separately: `turn/end` maps `completed` to
`done`, `error` to `error`, `aborted` to `aborted`, and other reasons to `ended`.
Session identity and turn number reject stale/duplicate results. A plugin loaded
mid-turn can accept the live end of its exact running agent without having seen
the start; an idle session's history is not replayed.

The optional `result` contains a monotonic `id` and terminal `state`. Python
keeps the result bubble for 3.8 seconds even when activity becomes idle; it then
returns to **空闲中，随时待命** (or the thinking bubble if work remains). While
any agent is running the pet keeps its thinking expression; when idle it can
briefly play the result animation. Repeating an id does not extend its deadline
or replay an expired result. A new run or `turn/start` clears the old result
immediately, including consecutive turns in one running interval. When several
agents finish, the latest accepted result replaces the previous notification.
Omitting `result` clears a notification; idle alone never means success.
Legacy `pet.state` terminal values remain supported by Python.
Chat messages keep the same line framing:
`id` is echoed back, `reason` is `completed`/`truncated`, and failures arrive as
`chat/error` so the dialog never stays pending without an explanation. Chat ids
are numbered independently from ping ids. `chat/history` carries the persisted
conversation back to the dialog once at plugin startup. The conversation is
stored by the plugin (see below) and is never written to a DSH session log, so
nothing from the pet dialog appears in the DSH conversation.

## Chat dialog

Click the robot's screen face or use the right-click menu item
**打开对话框**. The dialog keeps its history while hidden and offers:

- Enter to send, Esc (or ✕) to hide;
- a muted **DSH 正在思考…** line while the Host works on the request;
- pet replies as left bubbles, your own messages as right bubbles, and
  failures as red bubbles;
- input disabled while a request is outstanding, re-enabled on reply or error;
- the saved conversation is restored on open, with a date divider per day.

### How the Host answers a message

The plugin does not create a session, a second Harness, or an API key. It calls
the model that the user's DSH installation is already configured with:

1. `index.js` → `DeskpetChat` resolves the route from
   `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` (or the `chatProvider`/`chatModel`
   config override);
2. it streams the request through `ctx.llm.stream({ provider, model, messages,
   system, maxTokens, signal })` — the same service the DSH agent loop uses, so
   the user's provider, credentials, and model settings apply unchanged;
3. text deltas are assembled locally into the reply and sent to Python as
   `chat/reply`.

### Data and privacy

- Chat text is sent to the provider/model configured in DSH. When long-term
  memory is enabled, the recent transcript is also sent periodically to the
  same model to distil a user profile.
- Chat history and the distilled profile are stored locally as plaintext JSON
  under `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/` by default. They are not encrypted.
- The pet does not create or write a DSH session, so pet chat is separate from
  the DSH conversation log. It still uses DSH's configured model credentials.
- `chatHistoryPath` and `chatMemoryPath` control where the local files live;
  `chatMemoryEnabled: false` disables profile extraction and injection.

### Memory (conversation persistence)

The pet is meant to be a companion that remembers, so the conversation is saved
across restarts instead of living only in the dialog:

- every completed user/assistant turn is appended to
  `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/chat-history.json` (override with `chatHistoryPath`);
- writes are atomic (temp file + rename) and a corrupted file is renamed to
  `chat-history.json.corrupt-<timestamp>` instead of blocking chat;
- on startup the Host loads the file, keeps the most recent
  `chatHistoryMessages` turns as model context, and sends the retained history
  to Python as one `chat/history` message, so reopening the dialog shows the
  previous conversation (grouped by date).
- `chatHistoryMaxMessages` caps the stored/displayed history; the plugin also
  saves synchronously on unload so the last turn is not lost.

None of this touches a DSH session: the file is the pet's own memory.

### Long-term memory (a pet that understands you over time)

Raw history only reaches back `chatHistoryMessages` messages, so the pet also
distils a compact user profile and grows it as you chat:

- every `chatMemoryUpdateEveryTurns` completed turns, the plugin makes one
  lightweight model call (`memoryExtractionPrompt`) that merges the recent
  conversation with the existing profile and outputs a JSON list of facts
  (`preference` / `habit` / `goal` / `fact` / `relation`, at most
  `chatMemoryMaxFacts` items);
- the profile is stored at `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/user-memory.json` (atomic write,
  corrupted files quarantined) and is loaded on startup;
- after loading, the profile is appended to the system prompt of every reply,
  so the pet keeps using what it learned even after history rolls over;
- the dialog title shows **已记住 N 件事** so the user can see the pet getting
  to know them;
- failures never block chat: invalid model output keeps the previous profile,
  and the next threshold retries;
- `chatMemoryEnabled: false` turns the whole layer off.

None of this touches a DSH session either: `chat-history.json` and
`user-memory.json` are the pet's own files.

## Configuration

The chat dialog's **记忆** button opens a refreshable list. Deletion uses a
stable fact id and snapshot revision, asks for confirmation, and updates the UI
only after atomic persistence succeeds. An expired list must be refreshed.
Requests time out after 15 seconds and can be retried by refreshing.

Deleting a fact preserves chat history, stops re-distilling earlier user turns,
and filters the normalized text hash of the removed fact. New paraphrases may
still be learned from later conversations; this is not erasure of chat history
or provider-side data. Storage remains version 1 with additive `forgottenAfter`
and `forgottenFactHashes` fields. Older plugin versions do not enforce these
deletion rules; back up data before downgrading.

Python → Host uses `memory/list` with request `id`, and `memory/delete` with
`id`, `factId`, and `revision`. Host replies with `chat/memory/details`
(`id`, `revision`, `enabled`, `items`) or `chat/memory/error` (`id`, `message`).

The active values are in [`cordis.patch.yml`](./cordis.patch.yml):

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | blank: automatic discovery | Explicit path → DSHPET_PYTHON → managed environment → PATH → standard Windows installation |
| `pingIntervalMs` | `15000` | Heartbeat interval |
| `pingTimeoutMs` | `5000` | Per-ping timeout |
| `handshakeTimeoutMs` | `5000` | Spawn plus startup-pong timeout |
| `shutdownTimeoutMs` | `3000` | Graceful shutdown wait before terminate |
| `chatProvider` / `chatModel` | DSH `agentDefaultModel` | Pin the model route; unset reuses the user's current DSH default |
| `chatSystemPrompt` | built-in 桌宠 prompt | System prompt sent with every pet conversation |
| `chatHistoryMessages` | `40` | Most messages carried into one request as model context |
| `chatHistoryMaxMessages` | `200` | Most messages kept in the saved/displayed history |
| `chatHistoryPath` | `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/chat-history.json` | Where the pet's conversation memory is stored |
| `chatMemoryEnabled` | `true` | Distil and inject the long-term user profile |
| `chatMemoryUpdateEveryTurns` | `4` | Completed turns between profile distillation calls |
| `chatMemoryMaxFacts` | `40` | Most facts kept in the distilled profile |
| `chatMemoryTranscriptMessages` | `24` | Recent messages fed to one distillation call |
| `chatMemoryPath` | `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/user-memory.json` | Where the long-term profile is stored |
| `chatMaxTokens` | `1024` | Output-token cap per reply |
| `chatTimeoutMs` | `180000` | How long the dialog waits for one model reply before reporting a timeout |
| `chatTimerEnabled` | `true` | Enable chat commands such as `计时 5 分钟` and `10 分钟后提醒我 喝水` |
| `chatTimerMaxActive` | `20` | Maximum concurrent timers/reminders |
| `chatTimerPath` | `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/timers.json` | Timer/reminder persistence file |
| `chatTimerSound` | `false` | Play a system beep when a timer fires |
| `chatProactiveEnabled` | `true` | Low-disturbance proactive greetings (at most once per day) |
| `chatProactiveLevel` | `quiet` | `quiet`, `balanced`, or `chatty` |
| `chatCompanionPath` | `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/companion.json` | Relationship/emotion persistence file |
| `chatEmotionEnabled` | `true` | Track a lightweight mood/energy state from conversation |
| `chatEventsEnabled` | `true` | Distil and recall concrete events from conversation |
| `chatEventUpdateEveryTurns` | `4` | Completed turns between event-memory extractions |
| `chatEventMaxEvents` | `50` | Maximum stored event memories |
| `chatEventPath` | `$DSH_HOME/deskpet/events.json` | Event-memory persistence file |

The Python script path is **not** configurable: it is resolved from the plugin
module URL as `python/deskpet_bridge.py`, so moving or renaming the plugin
directory keeps the script next to `index.js`.

To change the interpreter, edit the bundle patch and let the profile
recompose/restart, or add a higher-priority override in
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: deskpet
  name: dsh-deskpet
  config:
    pythonPath: 'C:\path\to\python.exe'
    pingIntervalMs: 15000
    pingTimeoutMs: 5000
    handshakeTimeoutMs: 5000
    shutdownTimeoutMs: 3000
```

The profile override replaces the whole `config` object; omitted fields are
filled by `normalizeConfig()` defaults.

Install the Python UI dependency into the interpreter named by `pythonPath`:

```powershell
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

`plugin_manager` installs the JS bundle; it does not install Python packages.

## Current installation state

The bundle is installed as a linked profile dependency and selected as a patch
layer:

- Bundle row: `include:deskpet` (`patchId: deskpet`)
- Install result: `application: "applied"`, no warnings
- At the end of verification the row was enabled and the Python child was
  running

Install and remove it through `plugin_manager` (or the **Plugins** page); do not
hand-edit the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` to install it.

## Verification performed

### 1. Automated smoke tests

| Test | Coverage | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/config-smoke.mjs` | native schema shape, defaults, invalid inputs, interpreter selection | 10/10 |
| `tests/chat-host-smoke.mjs` | request shape, context, history persistence, long-term memory, stable-ID memory management, stale-write protection, failures, timeout, cleanup | 25/25 |
| `tests/chat-ui-smoke.py` | dialog submit/reply/continuation/error, history restore, date dividers, memory view/delete confirmation, save failure, timeout and stale response handling | 39/39 |
| `tests/bridge-smoke.mjs` | apply cleanup, ping/pong, process exit, idempotent stop, state forwarding, EOF and timeout termination | 8/8 |
| `tests/agent-status-smoke.mjs` | availability/results, concurrency, continuous turns, stale instances/events, startup, cleanup | Passed |
| `tests/agent-status-ui-smoke.py` | 11 queue → Qt transitions, result deadlines, concurrency, legacy/malformed input, ping/shutdown | Passed |

The agent-status contract was checked against the installed runtime on
2026-11-06. These new checks use mock Host events and an offscreen Qt window;
they do not constitute a live DSH task verification after plugin reload.
Separate live verification on November 6–7, 2026 has now confirmed plugin
normal completion, cancellation, recovery, concurrent agents, idle unload/reload,
reload during an active task,
and history/memory-hint restoration. User-observed pet transitions were
cross-checked against real `turn/end` events and process counts where applicable; see
[`docs/live-status-validation.md`](./docs/live-status-validation.md) for evidence
and the remaining scenarios.

The bridge smoke test spawns a real Python child, so it needs full local access
on Windows; the plugin Host itself is not under the tool sandbox.

### 2. Live checks

- Enable/disable through `plugin_manager`: disabling leaves zero Python
  children, enabling restores one active row.
- Chat through the pet dialog uses the model already configured in DSH; the DSH
  conversation list stays unchanged (no session is created or written).
- History: restarting the plugin restores the previous conversation in the
  dialog, with one date divider per day.
- Long-term memory: after four turns the pet distils a user profile, shows
  **已记住 N 件事**, answers questions from it, and keeps it across restarts.
- Metadata: `package.json`, both locale files and the SVG parse; the bundle
  patch loads through the DSH loader and `plugin_manager`.
- Packed file list: `package.json` `files` includes `python/*.py` and
  `requirements.txt`, so the PySide6 window module is not omitted from a packed
  bundle.

## Next steps

The synchronized development workflow is in
[`docs/desktop-pet-workflow.md`](./docs/desktop-pet-workflow.md); the immediate
implementation and live-verification checklist is in
[`docs/next-phase.md`](./docs/next-phase.md). Activity/result integration,
memory management, and automated regressions are complete. Core live checks have
passed; remaining DSH scenarios are tracked separately in the validation record.
Config settings, portable Python discovery, isolated environment setup and
candidate-package checks are implemented. The user confirmed acceptance testing
passed on November 9, 2026 and authorized the `0.2.0-rc.1` prerelease.
Timers/reminders, relationship/emotion state, proactive care, event memory and
the current reliability fixes are included in the `0.2.1-rc.2` candidate.
A bundled Python executable remains a future delivery option, not a blocker for
the documented Python-environment delivery option.

See [`docs/RELEASE-STATUS.md`](./docs/RELEASE-STATUS.md) in the source checkout
